name: conductor-newtrack
conclusion_quantitative: conductor-newtrack (Ask) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 10+ clarification rules, 4 approval gates, 1 validation rule, 3 escalation rules. Strongest: clarification rules.
conclusion_qualitative: conductor-newtrack guides the user through creating a new Conductor track (a feature or bug fix), producing its spec and plan files. Most of its rules are about asking: one question at a time with suggested options, building the spec interactively. The user approves both the spec and the plan before anything is written. Every tool call is checked, and failures, missing setup or duplicate track names halt the run with a message to the user.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in a bullet point. The agent infers whether the track is a feature or something else and does not ask the user to classify it.

statements.quote: Do NOT ask the user to classify it.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ clarification rules (9 mandatory, 1 advisory; 3 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), 9 strict and 1 counted as a suggestion (it contains "recommended"), 3 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent asks for a track description if none was given and waits for it. It then asks a series of questions to build the spec, strictly one at a time, waiting for each answer and offering 2 to 3 options where possible, and summarizes its understanding before moving on: 3 to 5 questions for a feature, 2 to 3 for a bug or chore.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There are 4 rules, all strict, 2 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent presents the drafted spec and then the drafted plan for the user's review and approval, revising each until the user confirms.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. The agent must validate the success of every tool call.

statements.quote: CRITICAL: You must validate the success of every tool call.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 3 escalation rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 3 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, 3 tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. If a tool call fails the agent halts, announces the failure to the user and waits for instructions. It halts when the Conductor setup files are missing, and when a track with the same name already exists, explaining and suggesting a different name or resuming the existing track.
